purpose: Teach: アンダー/ハリケーン/レバー/セクハラ/ワープロ/メトロ/合気道/ダイヤル

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがアンダーアーマーって、スポーツ用品の話してたよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was talking about Under Armour — you know, the sports gear brand.
lines.style: Gentle, present attention. Soft opening. She's sharing something small and observed, not making a big deal of it. Warm smile underneath.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、ハリケーンの絵本見たんだ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I saw this picture book about hurricanes.
lines.style: Bright, eager energy. Quick pace, slight breathlessness from excitement. He's sharing something he found interesting, hoping she'll care too.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが、車のレバー使い方教えてくれたよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad taught me how to use the gears in a car.
lines.style: Reflective, a little surprised by the memory. Medium pace, noticing the small kindness. Voice settled, like she's turning it over in her mind.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、セクハラって悪いことだよね
lines.en: Mei-sis, sexual harassment is bad, right?
lines.style: Quiet, careful. Not alarmed, but testing the word itself — making sure he has it right. Sho's perceptiveness showing. Genuine question underneath.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんがワープロで思い出をつづってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your grandfather was writing down memories on a word processor.
lines.style: Soft wonder. Slower pace. She's struck by the image of it — the quiet work of preserving things. A little tender in the voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと東京メトロ乗ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I rode the Tokyo Metro with Dad!
lines.style: Bright, proud energy. Faster pace. He's telling her something big in his small world — a real outing, a memory. Genuine delight.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが合気道の話してたよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was talking about aikido.
lines.style: Easy, reflective. She's noticing the kinds of things his father shares — his interests, his world. Warm and present, not pushing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、ダイヤルの電話、初めて見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I saw a dial-up telephone for the first time.
lines.style: Wonder and slight amazement in the voice. Medium pace, lingering on the newness of it. He's close to her, sharing something that felt important to notice.
